blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language model (LM) alignment broadly aims to perturb a given LM Q Q into an aligned LM q q such that i) the outputs produced by q q and Q Q are ‘close’ in probability, ii) q q has a higher expected reward than Q Q . Two common techniques for LM alignment are: KL-constrained RL, which requires knowledge of the LM distribution and is computationally expensive, and the best-of- n n algorithm, which requires only sampling from the LM. The work of [ 1 ] established asymptotic closeness between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods for an m m –length i.i.d. token sequence output by the LM, in the limit as m m increases to infinity. However, the i.i.d. assumption is not representative of practical LMs, whose output sequences often have memory. In this paper, we extend the asymptotic closeness result to the case when the m m –length token sequence outputted by the LM is Markovian . Further, for finite-length output sequences – particularly, when m = 1 m=1 – we provide a complete characterization of LM distributions and reward functions for which the KL-divergence between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods is zero – a question first posed in [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 语言模型(LM)对齐广义上旨在将给定的LM Q Q搅拌成一个对齐的LM q q,这样一来q q 和 Q 产生的输出在概率上是"接近的",二) q q的预期回报比 Q 更高. LM对齐的两个常见技术是: KL 受限的 RL,它需要了解LM分布,并且计算成本昂贵;和nn最优算法,它只需要从LM中取样. [1]的工作在两种对齐方法产生的分布间确定了一个m-长度即LM的符号序列输出的不对称近距离性,在极限中,随着m m 的增加到无限. 然而,i.d.的假设并不代表实用的LMs,其输出序列往往具有内存. 在本文中,当LM输出的m – 长度符号序列是Markovian时,我们把不对称近距离结果延伸至案例. 此外,对于有限长输出序列(特别是当m=1m=1时),我们提供了LM分布和奖励函数的完整特征,两种对齐方法产生的分布之间的KL-潜水是0,这个问题首先在[1]中提出。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a central paradigm for generating natural language text and LLM-based systems are increasingly being adopted in practice [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Given a prompt x x , an autoregressive LLM defines a conditional probability distribution ℙ ( ⋅ | x ) \mathbb{P}(\cdot|x) over output token sequences, with ℙ ⁡ ( s | x ) \mathbb{P}(s|x) denoting the probability assigned to the response s s . LLMs are pretrained on large text corpora and may subsequently be adapted through task-specific fine-tuning or preference-based post-training [ 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型已成为生成自然语言文本的核心范式,基于LLM的系统在实务中越来越多地被采用[2,3,4]. 由于一个 prote x x , 自动回转 LLM 定义了一个条件概率分布 P (  | | |)\ mathbb{P} (\cdot|x) 相对于输出符号序列, 其中 P ⁡ (s| x)\ mathbb{P} (s|x) 表示分配给响应 s 的概率 。 LLMs在大文本corpora上进行预训,并随后可以通过针对特定任务的微调或基于偏好的后训[5,6]进行调整.

blocks.en: LLMs sometimes generate unrealistic and undesirable outputs. For instance, the outputs might contain factually incorrect information or reflect biases in the training data [ 5 , 7 ] . Sometimes, more specific properties of the generated output text, including fluency, linguistic style, and the avoidance of undesirable repetition, are targeted to be improved [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Desirable outputs are associated with a large ‘reward’ and undesirable outputs are associated with a small ‘reward’. It is thus desirable to perturb the LLM probability distribution to an aligned distribution that has a higher expected reward.
blocks.zh: 法学硕士有时产生不现实和不可取的产出。 例如,产出可能包含事实上不正确的信息或反映培训数据的偏差[5、7]。 有时,生成的输出文本的更具体属性,包括流利,语言风格,以及避免不可取的重复,将目标加以改进[8,9,10,11]. 理想产出与巨额 " 报酬 " 有关,不良产出与小额 " 报酬 " 有关。 因此,最好将LLM概率分布调整为具有较高预期回报的一致分布。

blocks.en: While several techniques for LLM alignment [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 6 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] exist in the literature, two of the most popular techniques, which are also grounded in theory, are i) KL-constrained reinforcement learning (RL), and ii) best-of- n n alignment. KL-constrained RL returns an aligned distribution (which we sometimes call the “KL-constrained RL distribution”) whose reward is maximized while ensuring that the KL-divergence between the reference LLM distribution, i.e., the LLM distribution before alignment, and the aligned LLM distribution is small. In best-of- n n alignment, the algorithm instead samples n n times from the reference LLM distribution, picking the maximum-reward output among n n outputs generated. Unlike KL-constrained RL that returns a deterministic, analytical solution, the best-of- n n algorithm returns a random response, the distribution of which we simply call the “best-of- n n distribution”.
blocks.zh: 虽然LLM对齐的几种技术[12,13,14,6,15,16,17]在文献中存在,但最受欢迎的两种技术也以理论为基础,是i)KL约束强化学习(RL),和ii)最佳n对齐. KL受约束的RL返回一个对齐的分布(我们有时称之为"KL受约束的RL分布"),其奖励被最大化,同时确保参考LLM分布之间的KL-潜水,即在对齐前的LLM分布,和对齐的LLM分布是小的. 在最优nn对齐时,算法从参考 LLM 分布中选择nn乘数,从产生的nn输出中选择最大回报输出. 与返回决定性分析解决方案的KL-约束RL不同,最优n算法返回随机响应,我们简单地称之为“最佳n分布”。

blocks.en: In the light of analytical results on the best-of- n n algorithm, the work of [ 1 ] establishes a connection between the KL-constrained RL and the best-of- n n distributions in the restricted setting where: i) the LLM generates sequences consisting of m m i.i.d. tokens as the response for each prompt, and ii) the reward of the length- m m sequence can be decomposed as the sum of the reward over individual tokens. Under these assumptions, the KL-constrained RL and the best-of- n n distributions, when n = Θ ⁡ ( exp ⁡ ( m ) ) n=\Theta(\exp(m)) , are asymptotically close as m m grows to infinity. In other words, the optimal KL-constrained RL policy, which requires knowledge of the reference LLM distribution , is asymptotically close to the computationally efficient best-of- n n policy, which requires no such knowledge.
blocks.zh: 根据n最优算法的分析结果,[1]的工作在限制设置中建立KL受约束的RL与n最佳分布之间的关联,其中: (一)LLM生成由m-i.d.令牌构成的序列,作为每个快件的响应; (二)长度-m令序的奖励可分解为单个令牌的奖励总和. 在这些假设下,当n = Θ (exp ⁡ (m)) n =\ Theta (\exp (m)) 时, KL 受约束的 RL 和 n 中最优的分布值在 m 增长到无穷时是不对称接近的. 换句话说,最佳的KL约束RL政策,需要了解参考LLM分布,它与计算效率最高的nn政策非常接近,不需要这种知识.

blocks.en: While the purpose of the two assumptions is to derive analytical connections between the two alignment methods for a simple, toy setting, the assumptions are not representative of the outputs of practical LLMs, which display a Markov dependence of responses conditioned on previous contexts [ 18 ] . An interesting question to ask, in this light, is: Is the connection between the two alignment methods a consequence of the i.i.d. nature of the tokens, or does it hold even in the presence of memory among outputs? A related question about removing i.i.d. LLM output assumption in [ 1 ] was posed in the same paper. We take up this question in our work, analyzing the setting of Markov LLM output distributions.
blocks.zh: 虽然这两个假设的目的是为简单,玩具的设置在两种对齐方法之间产生分析联系,但这些假设并不代表实用的LLMs的产出,它显示出马尔可夫依赖以以前上下文为条件的反应[18]. 从这个角度来说,值得问的一个有趣的问题是:两种对齐方法之间的关联是象征物性质的结果,还是即使在输出物中存在内存的情况下也存在? 同一份文件提出了关于删除[1]中LLM输出假设的相关问题。 我们在工作中讨论这个问题,分析马尔科夫LLM输出分布的设置.

blocks.en: Furthermore, the work of [ 1 , Section 5] also observed empirically that when the LLM distribution and the reward function are both randomly generated, the KL-divergence between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods is “small” even for “small” m m values, when the LLM outputs are i.i.d. A second question to be asked in this regard, also posed in [ 1 ] is: For small m m values, what LLM distributions and reward functions give rise to small KL-divergence between the distributions returned by the two alignment methods? In particular, what is the dependence of this KL-divergence on the vocabulary size? We spend the latter part of this paper providing partial progress on this question, when m = 1 m=1 .
blocks.zh: 此外,[第1节,第5节]的工作还从经验上观察到,当LLM的分布和奖励功能都是随机产生的时,两种对齐方法产生的分布之间的KL-潜水是“小”的,即使对于“小” m 值,当LLM输出是即d. 在这方面要问的第二个问题也在[1]中提出: 对于小 m m 值, LLM 分布和奖励函数在两种对齐方法返回的分布之间产生小的 KL 分布? 特别是,这种KL-潜水对词汇大小的依赖是什么? 我们花在本文件的后半部分,即当m=1m=1时,就这个问题提供部分进展。

blocks.en: Our Contributions. Our main contributions are hence an affirmative answer to the first question in the presence of memory, i.e., when the LLM outputs are Markov and when the reward function can be decomposed as the sum of local rewards of contexts, there is indeed an asymptotic closeness result between the KL-constrained RL and best-of- n n distributions. We mention that such local reward criteria arise naturally in controlled decoding and token-level objectives, including attribute control and repetition penalties [ 9 , 19 , 11 ] . When m = 1 m=1 , we also identify classes of LLM reference distributions and reward functions for which the distributions produced by the two alignment methods are close in KL–divergence. In addition, for certain special classes, we characterize how the KL–divergence between the two alignment methods depends on the vocabulary size, thereby making progress on the second question as well.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献。 因此,我们的主要贡献是在存在记忆的情况下对第一个问题的肯定答案,即当LLM输出是Markov时,当奖励功能可以作为当地对背景的奖励的总和而分解时,KL受约束的RL和最优n的分布之间确实有一个不对称的近距离结果. 我们提到,这种当地奖励标准自然出现在受控制的解码和象征性目标,包括属性控制和重复处罚[9、19、11]。 当m = 1 m = 1时,我们也确定LLM参考分布和奖励功能的类别,这两个对齐方法产生的分布在KL–潜水器中是接近的. 此外,对于某些特殊类别,我们描述两种对齐方法之间的KL-潜水如何取决于词汇大小,从而在第二个问题上也取得进展。

blocks.en: In this work, we studied two popular Language Model (LM) alignment methods: KL-constrained RL, which, although optimal in terms of expected reward, requires full knowledge of the LM distribution, and best-of- n n , which is a computationally inexpensive method widely adopted in practice. Assuming Markov LM outputs and local decomposition of rewards, we showed that the two aligned distributions are asymptotically close, as the length of the outputs increases to infinity. This answers an extension raised in [ 1 ] (which in fact studied the same problem under i.i.d. outputs) to a more practical setting. We further identified classes of LM distributions and reward functions for which the two aligned distributions remain close in a finite, non-asymptotic regime, making progress on another question posed in [ 1 ] . Future directions include analyzing asymptotic closeness under mixing assumptions and analyzing non-asymptotic closeness for arbitrary discrete distributions.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们研究了两种流行语言模型(LM)的校正方法:KL-约束RL,虽然在预期奖励方面最优,但要求充分了解LM的分布,最佳nn-n-,这是在实践中广泛采用的一种计算成本低廉的方法. 假设Markov LM输出和局部分解奖励,我们显示两个对齐的分布是不对称的接近的,因为输出的长度会增加到无限. 这为[1](事实上在产出项下研究了同样的问题)中提出的扩展提供了更实际的答案。 我们进一步查明了LM分配和奖励职能的类别,这两个统一分配在有限、非不对称的制度中仍然很接近,在[1]中提出的另一个问题上取得了进展。 未来的方向包括分析混合假设下的不对称近距离性,分析任意离散分布的非不对称近距离性.
